topic.title: Git Actions in Other Views and Editors

body.p: In addition to the dedicated Git views and the top-level Git menu, the Git Client add-on contributes Git actions to context menus in other parts of . The actions apply to the resource you right-click.
If the resource is not part of a Git repository, Git actions are not available. In the Project view, right-clicking a folder that is not part of a Git repository shows only Create repository here.

section.title: Where Context Menu Git Actions Are Available
section.p: The Git submenu is available for resources that belong to a Git repository. Its lists different actions depending on where you open it. The provided actions are listed in and described in their corresponding reference topics.
You can open the Git submenu from the following locations:

dlentry.dd: Right-click a file or folder and select the Git submenu.
Right-click a topic reference or map reference and select the Git submenu.
Right-click the currently edited file in Text or Author mode and select the Git submenu.
